success.metaDescription: Confirmation and status of a successful BCSentinel payment.
success.title: Your purchase was successful.
success.lead: Your BCSentinel access has been initiated. We are checking the order status and updating the license.
success.fineprint: If the status is not visible immediately, refresh the page after a few seconds. Without a session ID, only the general success message is shown.
success.doneSub: The page was opened without a session ID, so no live status request is performed.
success.missingCredentialsSub: Tenant ID or API token is missing in the browser for the live lookup. The license continues to be processed on the server.
success.processedSub: The checkout session was found. The final license status may still be synchronized in the background.
success.fallbackSub: The live lookup is currently unavailable. The purchase continues to be processed on the server.

cancel.metaDescription: Information after a cancelled BCSentinel checkout.
cancel.title: Payment cancelled
cancel.lead: The payment was not completed. Your access remains available and you can restart the purchase at any time.
cancel.boxText: The checkout was cancelled, payment verification failed, or the window was closed.
